title: Implement Request Logging Middleware
description: This feature provides detailed logging of incoming requests, allowing for better debugging and monitoring of the application. It will log request method, path, headers, and response status code. This will improve the overall reliability and maintainability of the framework
testCases: Test logging of successful GET request
Test logging of failed POST request with error
acceptance: The request logging middleware must log all incoming requests with their respective methods, paths, headers, and response status codes. The logs must be formatted in a clear and readable manner, and must be configurable to log different levels of detail.
reason: Implementing request logging middleware is a high-impact feature that will improve the debugging and monitoring capabilities of the framework, making it more attractive to developers and improving overall user experience
